hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card container and Inter font show some craft, but the color palette is a random shuffle of schemeTableau10, there is no typographic hierarchy inside the visualization itself, and the green 'New Dataset' button clashes with the blue active-state — functional and readable, but not deliberately designed.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout circle size and key functions on node joins; sunburst radiusScale is an identity no-op, bundle links keyed by array index (acceptable), no line.defined() but data has no gaps, and no bar/area baseline violations since all layouts are structural hierarchy encodings.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: The bundling slider fires a full drawFrame (300 paths + 200 nodes) on every input event with no RAF/debounce, and layout switches start new 1200ms svg.transition() calls without .interrupt(), causing mid-flight snaps on rapid clicks.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view circle pack with ~220 nodes and up to 300 bundle links reads cleanly — nesting communicates hierarchy, colors are restrained to 2–3 visible hues, and link opacity (0.15) keeps edges from overwhelming the nodes; animation quality across 7 layout transitions cannot be assessed from a static screenshot, and force layout with 220 nodes reheating on interaction is a latent overload risk.
